question: Which country did India defeat to win its first ever cricket World Cup title?
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Indies.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The final of the **1983 Cricket World Cup** was played between India and the West Indies at** Lord's on 25 June 1983.**
 
• This was the **third consecutive World Cup final appearance **for the West Indies, having won the last two Cricket World Cups.
 
• India, playing in their first final, defeated the West Indies to** claim their first World Cup title.**
 
• The match was the third consecutive World Cup final hosted at Lord's,** following those in 1975 and 1979.**
